subsection.title: Demo Scenario
subsection.description: - Describe the shortest connected execution of the approved Core User Flow. - Include only the starting context needed to run it. - For every step, state the Primary Persona action and visible expected product result. - End with one observable overall pass result. - Keep tested claims inside the approved Overview, Solution and User Flow, and explicit Out of Scope boundary. - Do not replace the journey with a feature list or screen tour.
subsection.example:
| Step | Primary Persona action | Visible expected result | |------|------------------------|-------------------------| | 1 | Enters an expression | Practice questions appear for that expression | | 2 | Answers the questions | The result appears and the expression is saved |
**Overall pass result:** The learner completes focused practice and can find the saved expression.
